title: Branding
description: Single source of truth for product naming and colours. Read by the web server (served live to browsers and the mobile app) and compiled into firmware/rig_firmware/branding.h by scripts/gen-branding.mjs.

name.description: Full product name shown in titles and headers.

shortName.description: Short name for tight spaces (app icon label, tab titles).

tagline.description: One-line description shown on the landing screen.

deviceName.description: mDNS hostname of the ESP32 (http://<deviceName>.local) and the default device id prefix. Lowercase letters, digits, dashes.

team.description: Team or author names shown on the landing screen (may be empty).

school.description: School or organisation shown on the landing screen (may be empty).

branches.description: Display names for the three monitored branches, in order (branch 1, 2, 3).

showQr.description: Show a QR code of the dashboard URL so visitors can open it on their phones.
